def transform(g):
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bar_rows=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1]
    bar_cols=[j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    for i in bar_rows:

    for j in bar_cols:
        for i in range(h): out[i][j]=2
    return out
